description:
Transcribe speech from a local audio file to text, with optional speaker diarization and word-level timestamps.

WHEN TO USE:
- Convert meeting recordings or voice memos to text
- Extract quotes from audio the user provides as a file path
- Transcribe a multi-speaker meeting and tell who said what (set diarize: true)

EXAMPLE: {"file_path": "/path/to/recording.mp3", "language_code": "en", "diarize": true}

RELATED TOOLS:
- generate_speech: the inverse operation (text to audio)
- forced_alignment: align a known transcript to audio instead of transcribing

RETURNS: enveloped text, word_count, language (caller-supplied code echoed as-is; an API-detected code is enveloped as untrusted content). With diarize, also utterances[] (speaker_id, start/end seconds, enveloped text) and speaker_count. With include_word_timestamps, also words[] (enveloped text, start/end, speaker_id when diarized). When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies. Standalone clients require the file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or os.tmpdir()).

COST: Credits based on audio duration.

diarization_threshold.description: Speaker-similarity threshold (0.1-0.4); higher predicts fewer distinct speakers. Only valid with diarize: true and no num_speakers (rejected otherwise).

diarize.description: When true, annotate which speaker is talking (adds utterances[] to the result). Default: false.

file_path.description: Absolute path to local audio file to transcribe. When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies; standalone clients require the file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or os.tmpdir()).

include_word_timestamps.description: When true, include the words[] array with per-word start/end times in the result. Default: false.

num_speakers.description: Maximum number of speakers (1-32) when known. Only valid with diarize: true (rejected otherwise).

tag_audio_events.description: When true, include non-speech events like "(laughter)" in the transcript. Default: false.

timestamps_granularity.description: Timestamp granularity in the API response. Default: word.

name: transcribe_audio
